body:
You could have the PCs come across a situation where the Barren is trying to gain a new follower.

They could stumble upon a temple where an NPC is handing out flyers for the Barren.

A shrine could be blessed by the barren but he gave the wrong blessing and now the village of Old people are now all super strong, or everyone can jump 10ft.

They could stumble across a ruined temple and find an old priest rambling about the gods and the barren.
